source_text: Et dixit Deus: ecce dedi vobis omne foenum seminale quod seminat semen super omnem terram, et omne lignum quod habet in semetipso fructum seminis sui, ut sit vobis in escam. Esca corporis et esca animae: Verbum Dei et virtutes. Haec Homiliae I clausula — a principio usque ad escam creaturae. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: And said God: behold I-gave to-you every hay seed-bearing which sows seed upon every earth, and every tree which has in itself fruit of-seed its, that it-may-be to-you for food. Food of-body and food of-soul: Word of-God and virtues. These of-Homily I closing — from beginning as-far-as to food of-creation. Amen.
pass_b_english: [[God said: Behold, I have given you every seed-bearing plant that sows seed upon the whole earth, and every tree that has in itself the fruit of its own seed, to be food for you >> Bible:Genesis 1:29]]. Food for the body and food for the soul: God’s Word and the virtues. This is Homily I’s close — from the beginning as far as the creature’s food. Amen.
